CustomField.description: Lookup to Route Sales Geo. Identifies which route this store is assigned to. Changing the route on an existing record automatically recalculates day sequences as MAX+1 on the new route.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the route this store belongs to. Changing the route will automatically recalculate day sequences to the next available number (MAX+1) on the new route.
